title: Meta-learned decision: View vs private residual allocation
hypothesis: A development-selected residual-validation controller allocates private residuals only to tasks outside the shared Mirror subspace, achieving at least 95% of always-private query quality while using fewer exact serialized N=20 bytes; it must improve over always-Mirror on out-of-subspace tasks and match the simple validation-threshold control.
physical_object: one shared 16D model basis with 2D Mirror subspace and optional private residual slots
mirror_coordinate: 2D task code, with a sparse per-task private residual only when validation indicates a miss
logical_multiplicity: many related and unrelated task functions with adaptive private capacity
controls: development-selected controller with support residual features

task.type: 16D linear regression with mixed in-subspace and out-of-subspace tasks

success_gate: Every fresh world: adaptive query NRMSE <=1.05x always-private; exact serialized N=20 bytes lower than always-private; improves over always-Mirror on out-of-subspace tasks; no worse than simple validation-threshold baseline.
failure_gate: Any quality/bytes gate miss, task type is not identified, or simple validation rule matches the controller at equal bytes.
boundaries: No claim about natural continual learning or language models.
SETA decomposition is conceptually relevant but not reproduced.

amendments.reason: Clarify counts: 40 held-out task IDs per seed/world, 3 seeds, for 120 task instances per fresh world. No condition or threshold changed.

Development found no threshold meeting near-private quality under the initial residual-only refit, exposing that private allocation must permit a full per-task vector to repair biased Mirror coordinates. When selected, private mode now fits and stores the full 16D task vector. The learned controller is trained on development validation-residual features to predict whether full private fitting improves query loss; threshold fallback rule is explicit if no dev threshold meets the quality constraint.
amendments.private_representation: full 16D task vector replaces 2D View code when selected
amendments.threshold_fallback: if no threshold meets dev 1.05x private quality, choose threshold with lowest dev adaptive query error and record infeasibility
amendments.controller_training: development-only logistic classifier on validation residual to predict private-fit improvement
